consumer.decision: Evidence for the v0.3.0 filesystem/Events release gate. Native runtime and complete same-baseline regression qualification remain required.

defect: First-class filesystem/Events facades changed supported CommonJS lowering, authority footprints and observable once behavior. This record qualifies bounded source-based fixes without relaxing Unknown host exception provenance or IFC sinks.
supersession_condition: Supersede with successful canonical native runtime/GC/admission tests and a complete named-test comparison against v0.2.0 on the same pinned nightly, followed by all established release gates.
deletion_condition: This scoped record and generator may be removed after a durable canonical qualification artifact references these inputs/results and issue6/bd-15w28 releasekeeping no longer depends on the temporary subset.

scope.kind: Native diagnostic crate built from exact production parser, lowerer and authority source; extracted production test bodies called through temporary entrypoints. Not the canonical cargo test library target.
exact_interpreter_metadata: regexp_syntax, regexp_backtrack modules; exact regexp_input code-unit helper and constants
exclusions: capability::trust_zone is unused by this diagnostic and excluded at its module declaration
InterpreterCore execution implementation is excluded; its name is only a namespace for the verbatim static regexp_builder method
Native fs Promise dispatcher, host hooks, queued settlement, GC collector and runtime integration tests were not compiled or executed by this subset
Full engine/core runtime and the complete library suite are excluded
This run is not a v0.2.0 native binary comparison, release build, clippy/format gate, installer gate or performance gate
scope.host_exception_context: Original authority inputs use analyze_authority_footprint with Unknown provider provenance. No authenticated-provider substitution or IFC source/sink weakening was applied.

native_executable.storage: lossless gzip of genuine native ELF; execution uses decompressed bytes via Linux memfd

storage_workaround: The actual pinned native linker emitted ELF bytes to stdout; the identical bytes were losslessly gzip-stored and executed through Linux memfd. This avoids tmpfs link-output exhaustion and does not substitute interpreter execution or test results.

provenance.scope: Exact production test bodies plus exact supporting test helpers through temporary entrypoints, not canonical cargo test or interpreter execution
